title: ✨ All-New No-Crop Blur Canvas Studio! 📸
message: Never crop your favorite photos again! Fit any picture into Instagram Square (1:1), Story (9:16), or Wide (16:9) formats with beautiful blurred backgrounds.
points: 🎨 No-Crop Smart Canvas: Fit your whole photo into square, story, or banner sizes without cutting anything out.
✨ Dynamic Blur Background: Fills borders with a soft, natural blur of your original picture.
🌈 Color & Transparency: Switch between dynamic blur, solid colors, or transparent PNG canvases in one tap.
⚡ Batch & Custom Mode: Style all your photos together or give each photo its own unique size and look.
👀 Live Instant Preview: Tap and hold to compare original and new canvases before saving to gallery.

title: 📐 All-New Image Resizer & Passport Photo Tool! 🚀
message: We have added a powerful new Image Resizer tool to Smart Tools! Now you can easily convert any photo into exact pixel dimensions for passport applications, government forms, or social media.
points: 🎯 Custom Canvas Resizing: Easily resize photos to exact sizes like 600x600 pixels without distorting your original image.
🖼️ 3 Placement Modes: Choose Fit Center, Crop Fill, or Stretch for perfect image placement on your canvas.
⚡ Passport & HD Presets: Instant one-tap presets for standard Passport, Square, and Full HD dimensions.
👀 Side-by-Side Comparison: See live previews of your original photo alongside the new resized canvas before exporting.

title: 🌟 Discover DevDuo Software Hub & New App Experience! 🚀
message: We are excited to launch the DevDuo Software Hub inside the app! Easily explore our growing collection of powerful apps and games, check out upcoming features, and stay up to date with new releases seamlessly.
points: 🚀 DevDuo Software Hub: Explore all apps and games created by DevDuo with detailed feature highlights, screenshots, and direct download links.
📢 Release Notes & Updates: Easily view new feature announcements and update notes inside the app.
⚡ Smooth Navigation & UI Enhancements: Optimized list scrolling, transitions, and layout fluidity across all screen sizes.

title: ✂️ Precision Crop Studio & Batch Inline Framing! 🎨
message: Advanced on-device image cropping, batch row menu controls, and instantaneous state recalculations have officially arrived! ⚡
points: ✂️ Precision Single Crop: Adjust handles, rotate, and frame your base photos locally. Downstream target KB search scripts and sliders update instantly.
📦 Batch Menu Studio: A premium context-action menu replaces old card layouts, enabling you to crop, preview, or delete queue items independently.
⚡ Instant Processing Sync: Background loader indicators clear on point when cropped batch models finish automatic layout compression routines.
🔒 Transaction State Tracking: Optimized billing fallback logic to elegantly preserve paywall sheet contexts upon payment cycle cancel actions.

title: 📐 Target Resolution & Individual Studio Mode! 🎨
message: Desktop-class image resolution downscaling and manual item-by-item batch editing are finally here! ⚡
points: 📐 Target Resolution: Manually downscale image canvas dimensions (75%, 50%, 24%) to strip megapixels away instantly.
🎨 Individual Studio Mode: Turn off global rules in batch mode to adjust custom presets, sizes, and formats on each photo independently.
⚡ Dynamic Sizing Refreshes: Summary card metrics and new sizing rows now update instantly upon altering resolution dropdown configurations.
🛠️ Under-the-hood optimization improvements for faster, safer multi-threaded batch operations.

title: 📄 PDF Exports & Smarter Sweeping! 🧹
message: We've supercharged your workflow with brand new export options and advanced storage cleaning tools. ⚡
points: 📄 Instant PDF Export: Merge your compressed images directly into a single, shareable PDF document.
🎛️ Custom Sweeper Size: Set your own exact MB limit in the Storage Sweeper to find exactly what you want.
🔄 Quick Rescan: Easily restart your gallery scans with our new quick-action button in the Sweeper.
🛠️ Under-the-hood performance improvements for faster batch processing.

title: ✨ The Update Hub is Here! 🚀
message: We've crafted a beautiful new way to keep you perfectly in sync with our latest tools and features. 🌿
